parse_adsorption_energy_data: parse the raw adsorption_energy.txt file and extract MOF names, defect info, and adsorption energies into a structured DataFrame
filter_promising_mofs: filter MOFs where CO2 adsorption energy is below -0.5 eV and lower than H2O adsorption energy
compute_lowest_energy_per_mof: compute the lowest adsorption energy per MOF across multiple configurations for CO2, H2O, and co-adsorption cases
separate_pristine_and_defective: separate the complete dataset into pristine and defective MOF subsets based on defect concentration and index columns
plot_parity_scatter: generate a parity scatter plot comparing CO2 vs H2O adsorption energies for pristine and defective MOFs
